packageName: Rain Bird LNK/LNK2 WiFi Module Controller
author: Marc Hedish
releaseNotes: v1.0.2.10 – runZone() rejects 0/missing/invalid durations (1–360 min); Legacy opcode 03 / BF decoding restored for non-ESP-TM2 controllers; Program schedule read (0x20) and write (0x21) with read-back verification; HTTPS transport for current LNK2 module firmware (automatic HTTP fallback for first-generation LNK), plus zone-run, active-zone, watering-state, controller-date, and model-name fixes. Further details in CHANGELOG.md
